plugins.name: omp-kafka
plugins.description: Consume Kafka topics into a Tau/omp session in auto (push) or pull mode.

plugins.name: omp-edit-committer
plugins.description: Auto-commit every Edit/Write with a descriptive message and surface the SHA in the TUI.

plugins.name: omp-model-router
plugins.description: Cost-optimized model routing for Tau/omp — routes prompts to cheap/mid/expensive models based on task complexity. Tracks per-turn and session costs.

plugins.name: pi-tasks
plugins.description: Claude Code-style task tracking and coordination: structured multi-step tasks, dependency management, background task processes, and a persistent visual task widget.

plugins.name: pi-workflow
plugins.description: Workflow orchestration for Tau: named, repeatable multi-step workflows (research, code review, spec checks) coordinating subagent workers across steps, with run inspection, stop, and resume.

plugins.name: pi-agent-browser-native
plugins.description: Expose agent-browser as a native Tau tool: scripted browser automation (navigate, snapshot, act, extract) with session management, batch lifecycle, and hardened command policies.

plugins.name: omp-best-of
plugins.description: Best-of-N coding agents with LLM-as-a-verifier selection: runs N candidates in isolated git worktrees, ranks trajectories with a verifier model, and applies only the winning patch.

plugins.name: gsd-omp
plugins.description: GSD Embeddable Orchestration System host plugin for Tau: binds the native extension, command, event, task, and filesystem surfaces to GSD via the Host-Integration SDK, with optional Goal Mode status mirroring.
